$comment: requires_bootstrap is 0.160.0, the first bootstrap that holds a plugin venv at the highest released version of a first-party package its pyproject requires (the released-target venv stamp) and revokes undeclared bootstrap-written .pth links. The venv needs that because it installs katsoft-llm-kit (>=1.3,<2), whose llm_kit.adapters.codex_command is what the bootstrap_lib.codex alias resolves to, so the venv's llm_kit is the wheel and never a stale link. The highest call shape this plugin needs is older, bootstrap 0.137.0. Every ledger transition records an execution event through bootstrap_lib.execution_event -- make_event(..., schema=) with plugins-kit.execution-event/v1 for every event and plugins-kit.execution-event/v2 for the interrupt event (SUPPORTED_SCHEMAS must hold both), usage_payload, utc_timestamp, validate_stream, and JsonlSink(path, mode='create') for `job-kit events --out` -- a call shape first shipped in bootstrap 0.136.0; job-kit also validates model declarations with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse (bootstrap 0.129.0). Interrupt requests and resolutions are checked by bootstrap_lib.interrupt_contract (SUPPORTED_CONTRACTS must hold plugins-kit.interrupt-contract/v1; check_request, parse_request_document, validate_input, decision_outcome, same_resolution, expiry, bound_reason and resolution_document with the keyword shapes job_kit.interrupts binds), first shipped in bootstrap 0.137.0. The contract validates through llm_scripting_kit.completion.json_schema under the frozen subset selector (SUPPORTED_SUBSETS, check_schema(schema, subset=), validate(schema, value, subset=)), first shipped in llm-scripting-kit 0.56.0, which is the first floor of the llm-scripting-kit entry below; job-kit also imports llm_scripting_kit.completion.requirements.arm_call and passes HaltError(retry_after_s=...) through its backpressure wait, both first shipped in llm-scripting-kit 0.61.0 and probed by job_kit.select, which is the current min_version. Edge to bootstrap_lib.claudx, class REFUSE. Under a claudx session (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_TEST set, the maintainer test harness) run_contract probes contract_command lazily, inserting its --plugin-dir flags into a contract command whose executable is claude and refusing claude --bg and respawn; without the module the child would load the published plugins against the redirected data root, so the refusal names an absent bootstrap_lib (claude plugin install bootstrap@plugins-kit) and a bootstrap_lib that lacks the claudx module or the symbol (claude plugin update bootstrap@plugins-kit) in distinct messages, each naming bootstrap >= 0.154.1, before any process starts. The artifact stays true because a claudx result is read as produced by the plugins under test, which an uncontained child would falsify, so nothing is produced instead. Outside claudx the module is never imported and no call is made on any consumer path, so the edge adds no requires_bootstrap floor (nested claude children, engine-internals.md).
